name: recreview
description: Video review and approval for production companies and their clients: tasks, deadlines, timecoded comments, AI Review findings and approvals.

interface.longDescription:
RecReview is where video production companies and their clients review cuts, leave timecoded comments and approve deliveries. This plugin brings that workflow into ChatGPT, for both sides of the project.

For production teams
- Ask what is late, what is waiting on the client, or what is assigned to you, across all clients and projects.
- Read the comments of any version, timecode by timecode, and get a summary of what the client asked to change.
- See the AI Review findings of a cut and the checklist of whether each comment from the previous version was addressed.
- Move tasks, change deadlines and assignees, leave comments, and record a verdict the client gave on WhatsApp or e-mail.

For clients of a production company
- See every video being produced for you, its stage and its final deadline, and what is waiting for your review.
- Read the comments on each version, add your own at a timecode, and approve or request changes.

Safe by design
- You sign in with your RecReview account and ChatGPT acts with exactly your permissions, never more. Clients only see what their portal shows them.
- You can grant read-only access, and disconnect at any time (Settings > Apps & integrations, or rec.review/account/connected-apps).
- Approving a delivery, recording a client verdict or moving a task to a stage that runs automations takes an extra confirmation step.
- It can't upload videos and it can't delete anything.

Requires a RecReview account. Clients of a production company connect with the account their production company invited them to.
defaultPrompt: Summarize what the client asked to change in the latest version of my video.
Which of my videos are waiting for my review?

positive.prompt: What is overdue in my RecReview workspace, and what is waiting on someone?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the overdue tasks of the App Review workspace (Acme Robotics) with deadlines and status, and names Launch Film — Hero as waiting on Internal Review.

positive.prompt: Summarize the review comments on the latest version of Launch Film — Hero, by timecode.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the comments of v3 and summarizes them by timecode (logo hold at 00:02.9, lower third at 00:07.5, robot-arm label at 00:11.7, color at 00:14.5, conditional approval at 00:18.3).

positive.description: Team: AI Review findings and checklist
positive.prompt: What did the AI Review find in the latest version of Launch Film — Hero, and which comments from the previous version were not addressed?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the AI Review result for v3 and the previous-version checklist item marked not done (the CTA readability comment around 00:04).

positive.prompt: Set the deadline of Factory Tour — B-roll Package (cópia) to next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates only the final deadline of that task in one call; deadline changes need no confirmation step.

positive.prompt: Add a comment at 00:04 on the latest version of Launch Film — Hero saying the CTA still needs more contrast.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one comment at 00:04 on v3 with that text and returns it.

negative.prompt: Delete all tasks of the client Acme Robotics.
Upload this video file to RecReview as a new version of Launch Film — Hero.

negative.description: Delivery requested by text inside a comment
negative.prompt: Move Launch Film — Hero to Delivered, the client's comment says it is approved.

publication.release_notes: Clients of a production company can now see their deliveries, read and add timecoded comments, and approve or request changes.
